is.t: Validate the original PDF catalog data before importing products and product variants into MongoDB.
The four original 2026 Whyte price-list PDFs. No product data has been invented.
Tactus, Tactus Color, Tactus VLUXE, Tactus Color EDGE
One catalog line is represented as a candidate base Product. Variant rows represent Automation Tier × Surface Finish price combinations.
Remote/Acrylic, Remote/Glass, WiFi/Acrylic, WiFi/Glass, Zigbee/Acrylic, Zigbee/Glass.
Marked as Not available; no price is inserted.
Marked Needs review; no price is inserted.
Left blank for manual validation when the source catalog does not explicitly provide a code. Do not invent codes.
Taken directly from the PDF catalog.
Review Product_Review first, then Variant_Review. Fill Validation Status / Reviewer Notes before DB import.
This workbook is a validation layer. It is not yet the MongoDB import file.
Product images were extracted from the four source 2026 PDFs and embedded at Product level in Catalog_Rows and Product_Review. Image File gives the corresponding extracted image path.
